title: Stool Test Report
description: A stool chemistry or stool analysis lab report, as a clinician or a lab-data pipeline reads it: who and what was tested, when, and each analyte's result against its reference interval.

report_title.description: The report's title from the page banner, e.g. 'Stool Chemistries'.

laboratory.description: The laboratory that performed the analysis, from the page footer.

name.description: Name of the lab that analyzed the specimen ('Analyzed by ...').

address.description: The analyzing lab's address as printed.

lab_director.description: Lab director named in the footer.

clia_id.description: The CLIA ID printed in the footer.

order.description: The order block at the top left of the report.

ordering_provider.description: The ordering doctor's name as printed.

patient.description: The patient block at the top centre of the report.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth exactly as printed (do not reformat).

specimen_dates.description: The sample collection block at the top right. Copy every date exactly as printed (do not reformat).

results.description: Every analyte row in the results table, in order, across all sections.

section.description: The section heading the row sits under, e.g. 'Digestion / Absorption', 'Inflammation', 'Short Chain Fatty Acids'.

analyte.description: Analyte name as printed, without footnote markers (*, †, ‡).

result.description: Result exactly as printed, including any comparator such as '>' or '<' (e.g. '>500', '<10', 'Negative').

unit.description: Unit as printed; null if the row has none.

outside_reference.description: True if the result falls outside its reference interval, judged by comparing the result with the interval.

commentary_topics.description: The analyte headings the lab's written commentary discusses (the bold sub-headings under 'Stool Chemistries' on the Commentary page).
